import pandas as pd
import requests
from io import StringIO

def task_func(csv_url_dict, sort_by_column="title"):
    if not csv_url_dict or "URL" not in csv_url_dict:
        raise ValueError("The dictionary must not be empty and must contain a 'URL' key.")

    url = csv_url_dict["URL"]
    response = requests.get(url)
    response.raise_for_status()

    df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(response.text))

    if sort_by_column not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError(f"Column '{sort_by_column}' not found in the CSV data.")

    sort_columns = [sort_by_column]
    if sort_by_column != "title" and "title" in df.columns:
        sort_columns.append("title")

    return df.sort_values(by=sort_columns, kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)
